review_roles.qc: Independent script and audiovisual QC specialists

safe_sequence: Owner approves exact writing candidate download/runtime; never paid/hosted fallback.
One model at a time: canary, then identical original Bengali cases; no default-thinking repetition without reviewed configuration.
Blind unchanged outputs + failures to qualified Bengali editor; owner records actual attributed feedback.
Approve exact image/video/TTS/audio checkpoint, component licenses, package revisions and existing/new physical compute separately.
Run bounded actual SDXL/vision/Wan/LTX/SVD/TTS/ACE/SFX canaries; measure process RSS/CUDA peaks/runtime and retain failed results.
Evaluate actual images/clips/audio with qualified visual/listening reviewers; adjust implementation only on evidence.
Bind genuinely accepted assets to EDL/continuity/QC; independent Director review and explicit owner approval before Growth/YouTube preparation.
remaining_runtime_limits: New ACE/Stable Audio/VLM workers are prospective: actual installed dependency/checkpoint compatibility not verified.
Stable Audio requires all auxiliary encoders/tokenizers in an approved fully local bundle/config; ambient caches/network are excluded.
Current Parler worker is CPU-only; pace/pause/phoneme alignment/lip-sync are planning targets, not supported synthesis controls.
Video adapter micro-budget is 9–81 native frames. 20-second planning shots require an explicit short benchmark window or a separately approved shot split/rebudget.
SVD is image-conditioned; prompt/acting/identity lock is not guaranteed.

Reference conditioning, native performance transfer, neural lip sync, advanced grading/compositing and broad VFX remain unsupported or separately researched; do not silently substitute text instructions.
General professional readiness is not established by any engineering test or checkbox.
